boundary_note: Bounded first pass for all six frozen records in the Northern Virginia Campaign. Preserve per-engagement dates, including the adjoining August 22–25 and 25–27 intervals and the separate August 28 Thoroughfare Gap and August 28–30 Manassas records; VA024 is a frozen aggregate-operation record. The live NPS campaign heading does not replace any battle interval. Opening personnel and exact effective command boundaries remain unresolved. Draft claims do not alter model inputs.

claims.rationale: No inspected return establishes matched personnel at a common opening boundary. Imported numerical estimates remain unchanged; this pass does not validate them as simultaneous opening forces.

claims.value: The frozen result is Inconclusive (Confederate strategic victory); the live NPS field reads Indecisive. Ropes calls the engagement indecisive, a repulse after which Pope withdrew into the Washington lines.
claims.rationale: Retain the original result and engagement interval; later movements and campaign contribution are different measures. No new probabilities or individual causal credit. The strategic qualifier is a campaign-level label, not a tactical margin.

claims.rationale: Original casualty returns were not inspected; preserve totals, categories, cutoffs and differences. No canonical reconciliation or casualty-based opening count; related actions must not be added without resolving population overlap.

open_questions: Returns and casualty categories remain deferred. Ropes reports no Federal loss of guns or prisoners at Chantilly (Appendix D) but gives no casualty figure.

NPS/CWSAC is one family; Ropes is one retrospective history written from the Federal standpoint by a civilian author. Reports and despatches quoted inside Ropes are not additional independently inspected families.
No automatic commander attribution, causal campaign score, morale/readiness number or battle/campaign double counting.
